header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: CPO mass production shifts value to integrated optical-electrical test platform suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce says growing AI data center high-speed transmission demand is accelerating CPO toward mass production, raising demand for integrated optical-electrical test equipment and software, with 2027 pivotal and 2028 critical for large-scale production readiness. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
TrendForce expects suppliers that integrate test equipment and provide production-scale services to strengthen their strategic positions as customers emphasize testing efficiency, quality and cost.

⟨update 2026-11-02 · TrendForce⟩ TrendForce forecasts the AI networking and interconnect market to grow from US$37.9bn in 2024 to US$279.8bn in 2027 (95% CAGR), with switches at US$105bn, pluggable optical transceivers at US$84.1bn, and NICs/DPUs at US$57.4bn in 2027. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩

header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: CPO mass production shifts value to integrated optical-electrical test platform suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce says growing AI data center high-speed transmission demand is accelerating CPO toward mass production, raising demand for integrated optical-electrical test equipment and software, with 2027 pivotal and 2028 critical for large-scale production readiness. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
TrendForce expects suppliers that integrate test equipment and provide production-scale services to strengthen their strategic positions as customers emphasize testing efficiency, quality and cost.

⟨update 2026-11-02 · TrendForce⟩ TrendForce forecasts the AI networking and interconnect market to grow from US$37.9bn in 2024 to US$279.8bn in 2027 (95% CAGR), with switches at US$105bn, pluggable optical transceivers at US$84.1bn, and NICs/DPUs at US$57.4bn in 2027. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
